name: tdis-whatsapp-service
description: Standalone service connecting a WhatsApp number (via Baileys, an unofficial WhatsApp Web protocol client) to the TDIS AI assistant. Deployed separately from the Next.js app — holds a persistent socket connection to WhatsApp, which a serverless/short-lived process can't do. Talks to the main app's existing /api/assistant/quote and /api/assistant/book-hold/[id] over HTTP; holds no database connection of its own.
